arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Monthly increases (in millions of dollars)
july_increase = 74.7 - 73.4  # = 1.3
august_increase = 76.1 - 74.7  # = 1.4
september_increase = 80.1 - 76.1  # = 4.0

print(f"July 1939 increase: {july_increase}")
print(f"August 1939 increase: {august_increase}")
print(f"September 1939 increase: {september_increase}")

# Mean of July and August
mean_jul_aug = (july_increase + august_increase) / 2
print(f"\nMean (July, Aug): {mean_jul_aug}")

# Standard deviation (population std with n=2)
variance = ((july_increase - mean_jul_aug)**2 + (august_increase - mean_jul_aug)**2) / 2
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Standard deviation: {std_dev}")

# Z-score
z_score = (september_increase - mean_jul_aug) / std_dev
print(f"\nZ-score: {z_score}")

# Determine if statistically unusual (threshold > 1.96)
is_unusual = z_score > 1.96
print(f"Is statistically unusual (z > 1.96)? {is_unusual}")

# Rounded to nearest hundredths
z_score_rounded = round(z_score, 2)
print(f"\nZ-score rounded to nearest hundredths: {z_score_rounded}")

status = "unusual" if is_unusual else "normal"
print(f"Answer: [{z_score_rounded}, {status}]")
EOF
